stories.title: Houthi strikes on Saudi oil infrastructure
stories.what: Yemen's Iran-aligned Houthis say they hit Saudi Arabia's Ras Tanura refinery, the kingdom's largest, with a ballistic missile, and also claim attacks on Saudi military aircraft.
stories.why_it_matters: Ras Tanura is a major crude and products loading region; attacks there raise war-risk premiums and can affect willingness to fix tonnage into the Gulf.
stories.latest: Houthis claimed the Ras Tanura missile strike on Tuesday.
sources: Houthi Missile Strikes Saudi Oil Refinery

stories.title: Iran's Hormuz authority targets Sinokor fleet
stories.what: Iran's Persian Gulf and Hormuz Strait authority (PGSA) says it will take legal action from 1 November against Sinokor vessels, alleging repeated violations of its Strait of Hormuz transit rules.
stories.why_it_matters: Enforcement action against a named operator in the world's busiest oil chokepoint creates transit and detention risk that charterers must price into Gulf voyages.
stories.latest: PGSA set a 1 November start date for the action.
sources: Iran’s Hormuz authority to take 'legal action' against Sinokor fleet

stories.title: QatarEnergy force majeure on Adriatic LNG
stories.what: Edison, a unit of EDF, received a new force majeure notice from QatarEnergy covering cargoes scheduled for the Adriatic LNG terminal in Italy until the end of December.
stories.why_it_matters: Extended force majeure removes scheduled LNG cargoes and the voyages that carry them, redirecting LNG carrier employment and European import flows.
sources: Edison: QatarEnergy extends force majeure until end of December

stories.title: Northern Sea Route transit volumes
stories.what: Russia says transit cargo on the Northern Sea Route will more than double in 2026, though volumes remain well below Moscow's original targets, and Western sanctions remain in place.
stories.why_it_matters: A functioning Arctic transit route is an alternative to Suez and Cape routings for some trades, with implications for tonne-mile demand and ice-class tonnage.
stories.latest: Russia published its doubling forecast for 2026 transit cargo.
sources: Russia Says Northern Sea Route Transit Cargo to Nearly Double in 2026

stories.title: VLCC fleet consolidation at International Seaways
stories.what: International Seaways announced it is expanding its VLCC fleet through a strategic combination, alongside a material agreement filing and an unregistered equity sale.
stories.why_it_matters: Consolidation of large crude tonnage concentrates control of VLCC supply, which affects how competitive the fixing market is for big crude stems.
stories.latest: Deal announced today via SEC filings.
sources: International Seaways Expands VLCC Fleet Through Strategic Combination
International Seaways entered a material agreement
